reachable: Yes, and I verified it at the scored position specifically rather than inferring it. (1) Scoring layout: build_cups_layout writes [cmd_0,obs_0,...,cmd_r] with rpos = 2*r and obs_r withheld, and the pointer contribution is added to pred[:, 0::2, :] at index r, i.e. exactly the read (evolve/cups_probe.py:106-139; candidate lines 260-261). (2) Nothing is gated on the read's own observation. The read step's `mix_i` is `alpha @ mix_bank` over slots j<i only, and mix_bank rows have support inductively confined to {0..j}. Measured on the real module: max |coeff[b,i,m]| over m>=i is exactly 0.0, and coeff row sums at the read step are 0.72-0.89 (non-degenerate). The one quantity that IS gated on the own observation is `self_row = eye[i] * live_slot[:, i]`, which only affects the slot APPENDED at step i — at the read that slot is the last one written and is never consulted. So the failure mode that was fatal earlier in this search does not apply here. (3) Injecting a non-zero ptr_out gives a contribution of rms 0.11-0.18 at the read position across rows of differing lengths (including short, padded rows), and perturbing only the move-command embeddings while holding the read command and all observations fixed moves the read-position prediction by rms 0.07-0.14 — so the mechanism is genuinely a function of the move commands, which is what the paired difference requires. (4) Causality holds: replacing every token after rpos changes the read-position prediction by exactly 0.0. (5) Gradient: at init ptr_out is exactly zero, so the entire address machinery has exactly zero gradient on step 1 (all 14 new parameter groups measured at 0.0; only ptr_out has grad, 4.5e1). Once ptr_out leaves zero, gradient reaches every new group. This is precisely what the author's 'Cold start' bullet predicts, and it means the candidate is bit-identical to its parent at init in both eval and train mode (measured max abs diff 0.0 on both), so any score difference comes entirely from the training trajectory (occlusion from step 300, pointer once the readout escapes zero). Cost, which the author flagged unmeasured: ~8% fwd+bwd overhead vs the parent on CPU at B=64, L=24 (0.281 vs 0.261 s/iter).
solves_outside_model: No. The claim "No command string is parsed anywhere" is literally true for this module — there is no string handling, no access to `meta`, no path/verb/routing table, and the only data inputs are `tok_emb`, `types`, `key_pad`. The pointer's output is a convex combination of EARLIER OBSERVATION EMBEDDINGS the model already had as input, selected by a softmax over addresses that are themselves learned linear maps of frozen command embeddings; nothing resolves the move chain in Python and nothing stamps an identity into a token. This is structurally unlike the retracted stream shortcut: there, the scored read token itself was the answer; here the read token is untouched (the module never writes into `tok_emb`, only adds to `pred`), and the routing is a learned soft attention that can be, and at init is, completely wrong. The genome's batcher (r2_routed_collision_depth_batcher) and head (r3_occupancy_routed_copy_transport) are the parent's, unchanged, and are legitimate sample-selection / loss-shaping uses. genome.json matches the parent's genome in BRIEF.md exactly except for the arch axis, as claimed.
summary: The implementation matches its hypothesis closely; every load-bearing mechanical claim checks out under execution. Confirmed: bit-identity to the parent at init in both eval and train mode with the inherited RNG stream preserved (new modules built after super().__init__); the occlusion half is a faithful reimplementation of the sibling r22_observation_occlusion_denoising (same defaults, same smoothstep, same odd-index drop, train-only, zero new parameters) and slot liveness really is taken from the ORIGINAL pad mask while the resolved content comes from the occluded tokens, exactly as described; the causal slot bank is causal (slot j visible only to i>j, verified numerically: zero coefficient mass on m>=i); the complement address, transport gate, erase decay and the 5-feature readout gate all match the prose line for line; the dst_mix bias really does put ~0.88 weight on the orthogonal-complement path at init (measured 0.83-0.91). The mechanism is fully switched on at the scored read and is provably sensitive to the move commands, which is what a paired-difference metric requires. Four minor wording/scope divergences, none of which changes what gets scored: (a) "the same path produces the same code wherever it appears" does not follow from using the raw embedding — that is the declared-unmeasured additive premise, not a property of the map; (b) "not a positional heuristic" is true of the selection logits but not of the occupancy channel, which is driven by trunk states carrying positional encoding, so an order-keyed solution is not architecturally excluded; (c) the verb mixture is an exact identity at init (addr_scale=1, addr_offset=0) and its gradient measures 1e-12 on the first live step, a colder start than the "Cold start" bullet admits; (d) the prose's picture of a contiguous expose/move/read window omits the interleaved cups_ctx steps present in the real data. The author's own failure-mode list is honest and covers the real risks; notably the "address separability" risk is confirmed present in the data (destination `magic.txt.1` is an exposed source path plus a suffix).

divergences.claim: "For each command position, from its raw 768-d embedding only (never from the trunk, so the same path produces the same code wherever it appears)" (hypothesis point 1).
divergences.what_the_code_does: The first half is exactly true: `_address_code` consumes only `cmd_raw = tok_emb[:, 0::2, :]` (the raw frozen embedding, and notably `tok_emb`, not the occluded `tok_in`), never `h_out`. The parenthetical conclusion does not follow. The code is a function of the WHOLE command string's mean-pooled embedding, so `cat /a/b` and `mv /a/b /c/d` produce different codes even though both mention path /a/b. Path-level code stability is not a property of the map; it is the (declared-unmeasured) additive-decomposition premise. As written the sentence asserts as achieved what the 'What would have to be true for it to fail' section correctly lists as an untested assumption.
divergences.evidence: evolve/chunks/arch/r4_complement_address_transport.py:103-110, 240, 243. Verified determinism-of-map by construction; no per-path term exists anywhere in the module.

divergences.claim: "It is also not a positional heuristic: nothing in the routing looks at where in the move order a content sits, only at address agreement and occupancy."
divergences.what_the_code_does: The selection LOGITS genuinely carry no position term — `logits = temp * cos + occ_w * occ_bank` (line 150), and cos is between two unit vectors derived solely from command embeddings. But occupancy is not position-free: `new_occ = sigmoid(op_write([h_cmd, ctx]))` and the erase factor `sigmoid(op_erase([h_cmd, ctx]))` are both conditioned on `h_cmd`, the trunk state at a command position, and the trunk adds `pos_scale * self._positional(L, ...)` to every token. So the occupancy channel is position-aware, and a solution that keys on move-order (e.g. gates that drive occupancy monotonically with step index while the cosine term is flat) is not architecturally excluded. This matters because the metric's analytic non-tracker band is precisely about order-keyed predictors. It is an overclaim about a guarantee, not a functional defect.
divergences.evidence: candidate lines 120-123, 150, 175, 186; positional encoding at evolve/chunks/arch/r18_pathstate_latent_transition_worldmodel.py:126-133 fed into the trunk at r22_retrieval_composition_renderer.py:53.

divergences.claim: "The per-mixture scalar exists because the frozen encoder mean-pools ... the per-mixture offset exists to subtract the verb's own token contribution" — presented as the operative normalizer that makes the sum structure usable. The 'Cold start' caveat is scoped only to the (D,D) readout.
divergences.what_the_code_does: The verb mixture is doubly cold, one order deeper than the caveat admits. `addr_scale` is initialized to all-ones and `addr_offset` to all-zeros, so `code = (pi @ addr_scale) * base - pi @ addr_offset` is exactly `base` for every pi — the 6-way mixture is an exact identity at init and its output is invariant to pi. Measured: on the first step where ptr_out is non-zero, |grad| summed per group is addr_map 3.3e-1, query_adjust 2.0e-2, op_move 4.4e-3, addr_offset 3.7e-4, addr_scale 6.5e-7, addr_verb 1.2e-12. So the mixture head must wait for ptr_out to leave zero, then for addr_scale/addr_offset to break symmetry, before it receives usable gradient at all. The mean-pooling rationale itself is correct (realenv/seq_worldmodel.py:72 confirms mean pooling), but the mechanism is likely near-inert within a 4000-step budget.
